component.name: WireView Pro II
component.summary: Monitor a Thermal Grizzly WireView Pro II GPU power meter

description.p: Unofficial Linux GUI for the Thermal Grizzly WireView Pro II GPU power monitor. It shows real-time voltage, current and power across all pins with live charts, lets you configure the device, log data to CSV, and raise desktop notifications on fault.

The app talks to the device directly over USB serial. No .NET runtime is required, and the optional wireview-hwmon kernel module is not needed. The WireView Pro II Noctua Edition is supported as well.
This is an unofficial, community-made port. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or supported by Thermal Grizzly or ElmorLabs.

screenshot.caption: Overview with live per-wire power, current and temperature

description.p: A Noctua preset in the theme editor gives any WireView Pro II the Noctua Edition's look. On a Noctua Edition, Restore defaults no longer asks for a backup, since a real unit's artwork is the stock image. LAN viewers of a wireviewd host hide external probes that are not connected. The Linux build drops its beta label. Noctua Edition support is verified on a real unit provided by Thermal Grizzly.

Upstream 1.0.8 port: WireView Pro II Noctua Edition support, Noctua Light and Noctua Dark themes with their backgrounds, bundled firmware v05 build 20260902_0741, averaging up to 5.7 s, a firmware update check by build date with product and downgrade gates, lower idle CPU use, detection of an unplugged device, and temperature sensors that are not connected are hidden.

Fixes: a chart legend crash, reconnecting a replugged device, flashing and restoring stay on the confirmed device, config writes change only the edited fields, gauge text in the light theme, duplicate rows in the live CSV export. The settings file is now readable by its owner only and written atomically.

wireviewd permission handling: commands the daemon refuses are reported with how to join the 'wireview' group, and a dead daemon socket is reconnected and retried once. The theme preview no longer fails on every connect for users outside the group. The udev rule is now 0660 root:dialout plus uaccess. hwmon mode reads power1_cap, pwm1 and energy1_input, and energy is carried in LAN publishing.
Upstream 1.0.7 feature port: in-app firmware updates over USB DFU, display theme editor with live preview, custom telemetry charts, per-power-cycle log browsing, fault table, collapsible navigation.
Fix phantom fault alerts: discard corrupt serial frames and debounce fault bits before alerting.
Beta: LAN monitoring - read, publish, and remotely configure WireViews on other machines over the LAN (HMAC-authenticated, off by default).
Adds a system-tray power readout with a live hwmon values dropdown.
